summary: Preferred modern source-generator package for ReactiveUI properties, commands, OAPHs, view wiring, and Fody-era migrations.
recommendedPatterns: Use ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators as the primary choice for new ReactiveUI code.
Generate migration guidance from ReactiveUI.Fody to ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators for legacy projects rather than preserving Fody by default.
avoidPatterns: Do not choose ReactiveUI.Fody for new projects when ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators is available.
Do not mix Fody and source generators randomly on the same code path.
Do not forget partial type requirements and generator package setup.
setupSteps: Add ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators with PrivateAssets=all when appropriate.
If migrating from ReactiveUI.Fody, remove Fody package/configuration and convert properties/commands incrementally.
commonPitfalls: Assuming generated members are visible to other generators in the same compilation round.
Leaving legacy Fody configuration behind after migration.

features: Reactive collection and bindable derived-list generation
options: Reactive SetModifier, Inheritance, UseRequired, and additional-property notifications
ReactiveCommand CanExecute, RunInBackground, OutputScheduler, AccessModifier, and attribute pass-through
IViewFor view/view-model registration lifetime: PerRequest, LazySingleton, or Constant
packageSelection: Use ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators with PrivateAssets=all for both lean ReactiveUI and ReactiveUI.Reactive consumers.
Minimum documented surface: C# 12, ReactiveUI 23.2.28+, and a supported Roslyn analyzer band.
sourceGeneratorGuidance: Primary choice for reactive properties, OAPHs, commands, IViewFor, IReactiveObject, generated collection notifications, and supported hosts.
Use hand-written RaiseAndSetIfChanged, ToProperty fields, ReactiveCommand.Create, or view registrations only when a documented generator limitation applies.
compatibilityNotes: The generator detects ReactiveUI 24 lean or .Reactive API surfaces automatically.
Participating types/members must meet partial-declaration and language-version requirements.
One generator cannot consume code or attributes emitted by another generator in the same compilation round.
migrationGuidance: Remove ReactiveUI.Fody, FodyWeavers.xml/xsd, and ReactiveUI.Fody.Helpers imports after converting members.
Convert properties, OAPHs, commands, views, and IReactiveObject implementations incrementally and inspect generated code/diagnostics after each slice.
